request: Whole-file writes should report lines added and removed too. The backend write tool (agent_tools.rs, used by agent_run/tools.rs) compares the file before and after (a line diff) and says so in its result: "wrote 3 bytes to hello.txt (+1 -0 lines)", with {added, removed} in the result's meta. In the frontend, editCounts in src/lib/toolGroups.ts now takes a list of {args, result?} (result being the meta) and counts a whole-file write from its result's counts, edits with old_text as before, skipping context edits; a whole-file write without counts doesn't count. Update callers and show the counts on "Wrote" lines and blocks.
